whenToUse: The website has about five main pages.
People need to jump to another section from any page.
A key action such as Sign in or Get started should always be visible.
whenNotToUse: There are many menu items and deep levels (use a sidebar or a mega menu).
On small screens (fold it into a hamburger menu).
You're switching between an app's main screens (use a bottom tab bar).
accessibility: Name the nav landmark ("Main menu") to tell it apart from other navigation.
Mark the current page with aria-current="page" and an underline, not color alone.
Links are real a elements, so default behavior such as opening in a new tab works.
The keyboard focus ring is visible.
